prompt: Non-test code under src/ reads configuration from LENS_-prefixed environment variables via std::env::var or std::env::var_os with a string-literal name. Excluding test code (anything gated by #[cfg(test)]), exactly how many DISTINCT LENS_* variable names are read that way? Count distinct names, not read sites. Count only reads where the string literal is the direct argument of std::env::var or std::env::var_os; reads routed through a helper function taking the name as a parameter do not count, and env WRITES (e.g. cmd.env(...)) do not count.
